bibl.title: The Byzantine Egyptian debt acknowledgement in transition from Greek to Coptic. Was Dioscorus of Aphrodito responsible?
bibl.seg: Elizabeth Buchanan, The Byzantine Egyptian debt acknowledgement in transition from Greek to Coptic. Was Dioscorus of Aphrodito responsible?

Sophie Démare-Lafont (ed.), Debt in Ancient Mediterranean Societies. A Documentary Approach. Legal Documents in Ancient Societies. VII. Paris, August 27-29, 2015 = École pratique des hautes études. Sciences historiques et philologiques. II. Hautes études orientales - Moyen et Proche-Orient. 8. 56 (Genève, 2019) pp. 193-214, figg.
bibl.note: The comparison of the temporal distribution of the Greek debt acknowledgements and of the Coptic ones suggests that while the catastrophic events of the 7th century tipped the balance for personal legal documents from Greek to Coptic, the roots of the change lie deep within the 6th century.
